short_description.database_value:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional networking platform, designed to connect the business community. Founded in 2002 and launched in 2003, it has grown into a comprehensive economic ecosystem known as the "Economic Graph," with over 1.2 billion registered members globally. Headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, LinkedIn is a subsidiary of Microsoft, acquired in 2016.

The platform offers a range of services categorized into four main areas: Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions. Talent Solutions help organizations find and hire talent, while Marketing Solutions enable brands to engage audiences through targeted advertising. Sales Solutions assist sales professionals in identifying leads and building relationships. Premium Subscriptions provide individual users with enhanced features for career advancement and networking. LinkedIn serves a diverse audience, including enterprises, small businesses, individual professionals, and educational institutions, making it a vital tool for economic opportunity and professional growth.
